docs.title: IBM Maximo © 7.6.x
docs.text:
• Unzip the release file Rodias-DragNDrop-x.y.z-ww.zip.
  • Copy the unzipped SMP folder into the [IBM] folder (e.g. C:\IBM, so that the folder C:\IBM\SMP exists).
  • Stop the Maximo application server in WebSphere.
  • Open a terminal as Administrator and navigate to [SMP]\maximo\tools\maximo.
  • Run:

updatedb.bat

  • Run:

TDToolkit -PMPUPDATEeamdragndrop -VERSIONV7100-00

  • Rebuild and redeploy the Maximo EAR file.
  • Start Maximo.

  • Register the Toolbox control:

    • Log in as maxadmin in Maximo.
    • Export the system application XML Toolbox. In some older Maximo versions it is not on the list — in that case use this link: http://maximo/maximo/ui/toolbox.xml?event=exportxml&targetid=toolbox
    • Open the toolbox.xml file in a text editor and add the line: <dnd id="ctrl_dnd"/>
    • Import the modified toolbox.xml file into Maximo.
    • Restart Maximo again.

  • The Drag & Drop tool is now installed. See the User Manual for how to configure applications in Maximo.

docs.title: Maximo Application Suite © (8 and Newer)
docs.text:
• Drag&Drop Tool is delivered as a ZIP archive. The filename will resemble: dragndrop_MAS-6.2.0.0.zip.
  • The ZIP archive is created according to IBM guidelines: Customization archive guidelines
  • If you have a download link for Drag&Drop Tool, download the file and make it accessible from your Maximo Application Suite through one of the following protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, or FTPS. Do not configure a Drag&Drop download link directly in your Maximo Application Suite. We cannot guarantee that such a link will remain available in the future (e.g., the HTTP server may be down, access rights may change, or the URL may change). Always use your own HTTP server.
  • To install Drag&Drop Tool in Maximo Application Suite, follow the IBM instructions: Adding customizations

docs.title: Configure Drag & Drop Image
docs.text:
The administrative application System properties is used to configure EAM Drag & Drop Image for a Maximo application.

  1. Navigate to the application System properties (module System Configuration → Platform Configuration).
  2. Find the system property eamdragndrop.imageUpload.activeApps:

  1. As Global Value give the comma separated names of the Maximo applications you want to activate Drag & Drop Image functionality for, e.g.:

…or, for only one application:

  1. Click the Save button.
  2. Select the checkbox next to the property you just modified.
  3. Select the Live Refresh action.
  4. Click OK.

docs.title: Configure Maximo application
docs.text:
The administrative applications Database configuration and Application designer are used to configure EAM Drag & Drop for a Maximo application.

  1. Start the Maximo application designer (module System Configuration → Platform Configuration).
  2. Navigate to the application in which "Drag and Drop" should be configured (in this case: ASSET – Assets):

  1. Back up the existing XML file of the application using the export functionality.
  2. Go to the main register of the application (or any other register in which "Drag & Drop" should be configured).
  3. Optionally: Use the standard design functionalities of the application designer to change layouts (for example add a new section next to the standard design element Attachments).
  4. Open the Controls panel and move the new element Drag and Drop to the right place inside your application design:

  1. Optionally: Change properties of the Drag and Drop control (width, height and/or label description):

  1. Add a button group to the application design, name the pushbutton Options Drag and Drop and assign EAMDNDCONF as Event:

  1. Save the application design.
  2. Remember the main object related to the application (in this case: ASSET).
  3. Go to the database configuration (module System Configuration → Platform Configuration).
  4. Find the main object (see step 9) and go to the register Relationships.
  5. Find out whether the relationship EAMDNDCONFIG, which belongs to the object, already exists.

  6. If not, add the relationship EAMDNDCONFIG with the following configuration:

    Field Value Relationship EAMDNDCONFIG Child Object EAMDNDCONFIG WHERE clause app = :&APPNAME& and userid = :&USERNAME&

  7. Save the changes.

docs.title: How to upload documents
docs.text:
Documents from another program (data source) can be attached to an object within a Maximo application using EAM Drag & Drop.

  1. Open the Maximo application, navigate to the Maximo record to which the documents should be added and open the main register (or another register containing EAM Drag and Drop).
  2. Open the data source (for example Windows Explorer, an email program …) and navigate to the relevant documents.
  3. Make sure that both the documents in the data source and the interactive Drag and Drop area of the Maximo application are visible on your screen.
  4. Highlight one or more documents in the data source.
  5. Move the highlighted documents to the interactive Drag and Drop area using the left mouse button.
  6. Documents will be automatically uploaded to Maximo, assigned to the current Maximo record and saved:

  1. Note: While uploading large documents, the progress bar in the Drag and Drop area shows the status of the activity.
  2. Note: Afterwards, the attached documents can be opened using the Maximo standard View Attachments:

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
EAM Drag & Drop for Maximo can be configured and used for every Maximo application that has Maximo standard attachments functionality.

The administrative applications Database configuration and Application designer are used to set up a configuration.

There is no need to change the application specific XML file manually. The changes in the database configuration can be made without using an administration mode or restarting the system.

At the client side, the browser has to support HTML5 to use the EAM Drag & Drop tool:

  • Internet Explorer (version 10 and higher)
  • Microsoft Edge
  • Firefox (version 4 and higher)

The following documentation is based on the Maximo application Assets (ASSET) as an example. The same procedure can be used for every Maximo application that supports attachments functionality.

It is assumed that the EAM Drag & Drop tool is properly installed. The details can be found in the installation manual.

docs.title: User and application specific settings
docs.text:
User and application specific settings can be made within the Drag and Drop application (in this example: Assets) which belongs to the current Maximo user. It is necessary to define these settings before Drag and Drop can be used for the first time.

  1. Log in with username and password.
  2. Navigate to the application (in this example: Assets), find any existing record and open the main register of the application (or another register configured for "Drag and Drop").
  3. The interactive Drag and Drop area is not visible at first without user specific settings:

  1. Click the button Options Drag and Drop.
  2. The following user options can be set within the related dialog:

  • Select a folder (mandatory setting): select a document folder where Drag and Drop elements will be saved later on (for example Attachments):

    Note: If no document folder is available, please contact your system administrator.

  • Use the document name with consecutive numbers / Name the document:

    • Activate the checkbox to name documents as defined and to extend the name with a consecutive number.
    • Deactivate the checkbox to use a consecutive number function only.

  • Advanced Options: These options are a copy of the Maximo standard Attachments. Use the Maximo user manual for details.

  • Click OK. The settings will be saved automatically and the interactive Drag and Drop area is visible and can be used.
